::: {.dynamic .horizontal}

::: {.controls}
Saisissez une phrase pour simuler la vectorisation. Pour obtenir des résultats pertinents, utilisez des termes liés aux thèmes suivants :
<ul class="mt-2 small text-sol-base1 list-unstyled ps-0">
  <li>🔹 <b>Informatique :</b> vpn, réseau, wifi, configurer, internet...</li>
  <li>🔹 <b>RH :</b> télétravail, congés, domicile, vacances...</li>
  <li>🔹 <b>Marketing :</b> budget, publicité, campagne, q3...</li>
</ul>
Interagissez avec l'espace 3D (<b>Clic + Glisser</b> pour pivoter, <b>Clic sur un mot</b> pour tracer le lien).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof userQuery = window.ui.text_area({
  label: "Texte à vectoriser :", 
  value: "Comment configurer le vpn pour le télétravail ?",
  rows: 2
})

viewof ragBtn = {
  const btn = Inputs.button("🌌 Projeter dans l'Espace 3D");
  btn.querySelector("button").className = "atom-btn";
  return btn;
}

// État partagé robuste pour capturer le clic depuis le SVG vers le Terminal
viewof selectedWordEvent = {
  const div = html`<div></div>`;
  div.value = null;
  return div;
}

```

::: {.render .transparent}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  ragBtn; // Déclencheur
  
  const width = 600;
  const height = 400;
  
  const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  svg.setAttribute("width", "100%");
  svg.setAttribute("height", height);
  // L'ajout de touch-action permet un meilleur comportement sur mobile/tablette
  svg.classList.add("rag-svg-container");

  svg.innerHTML = `
    <defs>
      <filter id="glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6" result="blur" />
        <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over" />
      </filter>
      <filter id="glow-line" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur" />
        <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over" />
      </filter>

    </defs>
    <g id="scene"></g>
    <g id="links"></g>
    <g id="labels"></g>
  `;
  
  const scene = svg.querySelector("#scene");
  const linksLayer = svg.querySelector("#links");
  const labelsLayer = svg.querySelector("#labels");

  // ==========================================
  // 1. DÉFINITION DES DOCUMENTS
  // ==========================================
  const docs = [
    { id: "Doc_IT", text: "Guide de configuration VPN et Support Réseau", x: -140, y: -60, z: 90, color: "#2aa198", kw: ["vpn", "support", "configurer", "réseau", "wifi", "informatique", "internet"] },
    { id: "Doc_RH", text: "Politique de Télétravail et Congés Payés", x: 120, y: 80, z: 60, color: "#859900", kw: ["télétravail", "maison", "domicile", "congés", "vacances", "rh"] },
    { id: "Doc_MK", text: "Budget et Campagnes Marketing Q3", x: 30, y: -100, z: -120, color: "#d33682", kw: ["budget", "marketing", "pub", "campagne", "q3", "publicité"] }
  ];

  // ==========================================
  // 2. PARSING ET PLACEMENT DES MOTS
  // ==========================================
  // On nettoie la ponctuation, on passe en minuscules pour dédoublonner et on filtre
  const seen = new Set();
  const rawWords = userQuery.replace(/[.,!?]/g, "").split(/\s+/).filter(w => {
    const lower = w.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(lower)) return false;
    seen.add(lower);
    return w.length > 0;
  });

  const stopWords = ["le", "la", "les", "l", "de", "d", "du", "des", "un", "une", "ce", "cet", "cette", "ces", "mon", "ton", "son", "ma", "ta", "sa", "mes", "tes", "ses", "notre", "votre", "leur", "nos", "vos", "leurs", "il", "elle", "ils", "elles", "je", "tu", "nous", "vous", "on", "se", "y", "lui", "eux", "et", "ou", "mais", "car", "ni", "or", "donc", "pour", "dans", "en", "par", "avec", "sans", "sous", "sur", "chez", "vers", "comme", "que", "qui", "quoi", "dont", "où", "est", "sont", "était", "étaient", "suis", "es", "sommes", "êtes", "a", "ont", "avait", "avaient", "ai", "as", "avons", "avez", "fait", "font", "va", "vont", "ne", "pas", "plus", "si", "bien", "très"];
  
  const words = rawWords.map((word, index) => {
    let lowerW = word.toLowerCase();
    let targetDoc = null;
    let wx, wy, wz;
    let isKeyWord = false;

    for (let d of docs) {
      if (d.kw.some(k => lowerW.includes(k) || k.includes(lowerW))) {
        targetDoc = d;
        isKeyWord = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (isKeyWord) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 60 + Math.random() * 40;
      wx = targetDoc.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      wy = targetDoc.y + (Math.random() * 60 - 30);
      wz = targetDoc.z + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
    } else if (stopWords.includes(lowerW)) {
      // Mots de grammaire : concentrés au centre pour libérer l'espace
      wx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
      wy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
      wz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
    } else {
      wx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
      wy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
      wz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
    }

    let nearestDist = Infinity;
    let nearestDoc = docs[0];
    docs.forEach(d => {
      let dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(d.x-wx, 2) + Math.pow(d.y-wy, 2) + Math.pow(d.z-wz, 2));
      if (dist < nearestDist) { nearestDist = dist; nearestDoc = d; }
    });

    return { type: "word", id: `w_${index}`, text: word, x: wx, y: wy, z: wz, isKeyWord, nearest: nearestDoc, distance: nearestDist, color: isKeyWord ? "#268bd2" : "#586e75" };
  });

  const docEntities = docs.map(d => ({...d, type: "doc"}));
  const docEntityMap = new Map(docs.map((d, i) => [d, docEntities[i]]));
  const entities = [...docEntities, ...words.map(w => ({...w, nearestEntity: docEntityMap.get(w.nearest)}))];
  const domMap = new Map();
  
  // Le trait de liaison
  const connectionLine = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
  connectionLine.setAttribute("stroke", "#b58900");
  connectionLine.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.5");
  connectionLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "6,4");
  connectionLine.setAttribute("filter", "url(#glow-line)");
  connectionLine.setAttribute("class", "animated-link");
  connectionLine.style.opacity = "0";
  linksLayer.appendChild(connectionLine);

  // Labels de coordonnées (pour la sélection)
  const coordLabelWord = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
  coordLabelWord.setAttribute("font-size", "10px");
  coordLabelWord.setAttribute("fill", "#268bd2");
  coordLabelWord.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
  coordLabelWord.setAttribute("font-weight", "bold");
  coordLabelWord.style.opacity = "0";
  coordLabelWord.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  labelsLayer.appendChild(coordLabelWord);

  const coordLabelDoc = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
  coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("font-size", "10px");
  coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("fill", "#b58900");
  coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
  coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("font-weight", "bold");
  coordLabelDoc.style.opacity = "0";
  coordLabelDoc.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  labelsLayer.appendChild(coordLabelDoc);

  let currentSelectedWord = null;

  entities.forEach(ent => {
    const group = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
    
    if (ent.type === "doc") {
      const selectionCircle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
      selectionCircle.setAttribute("r", "22");
      selectionCircle.setAttribute("fill", ent.color);
      selectionCircle.setAttribute("filter", "url(#glow)");
      selectionCircle.style.opacity = "0";
      selectionCircle.style.transition = "opacity 0.3s";

      const circle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
      circle.setAttribute("r", "16");
      circle.setAttribute("fill", ent.color);
      circle.setAttribute("filter", "url(#glow)");
      circle.setAttribute("opacity", "0.85");
      
      const icon = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      icon.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      icon.setAttribute("dy", "5");
      icon.setAttribute("fill", theme.base3);
      icon.setAttribute("font-size", "14px");
      icon.textContent = "📄";
      
      const label = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      label.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      label.setAttribute("dy", "-22");
      label.setAttribute("fill", ent.color);
      label.setAttribute("font-size", "12px");
      label.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
      label.setAttribute("font-weight", "bold");
      label.textContent = ent.id;

      group.appendChild(selectionCircle);
      group.appendChild(circle);
      group.appendChild(icon);
      group.appendChild(label);
      domMap.set(ent, { group, selectionCircle, label });
    } 
    else {
      const selectionCircle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
      selectionCircle.setAttribute("r", "22");
      selectionCircle.setAttribute("fill", ent.color);
      selectionCircle.setAttribute("filter", "url(#glow)");
      selectionCircle.style.opacity = "0";
      selectionCircle.style.transition = "opacity 0.3s";

      const text = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      text.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      text.setAttribute("fill", ent.color);
      text.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
      text.setAttribute("font-weight", ent.isKeyWord ? "bold" : "normal");
      text.style.transition = "fill 0.2s";
      text.textContent = ent.text; 
      
      const hitbox = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
      hitbox.setAttribute("r", "25");
      hitbox.setAttribute("fill", "transparent");
      hitbox.style.cursor = "pointer";
      
      // CLIC : Transmission de l'événement à OJS
      hitbox.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation(); 
        if (currentSelectedWord === ent) {
          currentSelectedWord = null;
          viewof selectedWordEvent.value = null;
        } else {
          currentSelectedWord = ent;
          viewof selectedWordEvent.value = ent;
          lineProgress = 0; // Relance l'animation de croissance
        }
        viewof selectedWordEvent.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
      });
      hitbox.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => text.setAttribute("fill", theme.base3));
      hitbox.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => text.setAttribute("fill", ent.color));

      group.appendChild(selectionCircle);
      group.appendChild(text);
      group.appendChild(hitbox);
      domMap.set(ent, { group, selectionCircle, text });
    }
    
    scene.appendChild(group);
  });

  // ==========================================
  // 3. MOTEUR 3D ET GESTION DE LA SOURIS (DRAG)
  // ==========================================
  let angleY = 0;
  let pitch = 0.3; // Angle de vue caméra (haut/bas)
  let velocityY = 0;
  let velocityPitch = 0;
  const friction = 0.96;
  
  let isDragging = false;
  let lastX = 0, lastY = 0;

  // Contrôles de rotation
  svg.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    // Si on clique sur le fond, on déselectionne
    if (e.target === svg) {
      currentSelectedWord = null;
      viewof selectedWordEvent.value = null;
      viewof selectedWordEvent.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
    }
    
    isDragging = true;
    lastX = e.clientX;
    lastY = e.clientY;
    svg.style.cursor = "grabbing";
  });

  const onMove = (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const deltaX = e.clientX - lastX;
    const deltaY = e.clientY - lastY;
    
    velocityY = deltaX * 0.012;
    velocityPitch = deltaY * 0.012;
    
    angleY -= velocityY;
    pitch -= velocityPitch;
    
    pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI/2.5, Math.min(Math.PI/2.5, pitch));
    
    lastX = e.clientX;
    lastY = e.clientY;
  };

  const onUp = () => {
    isDragging = false;
    svg.style.cursor = "grab";
  };

  window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);

  invalidation.then(() => {
    window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    isAnimating = false;
  });

  let isAnimating = true;
  let lineProgress = 0;

  function render3D() {
    if (!isAnimating) return;
    
    if (!isDragging) {
      // Inertie
      angleY -= velocityY;
      pitch -= velocityPitch;
      pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI/2.5, Math.min(Math.PI/2.5, pitch));
      
      velocityY *= friction;
      velocityPitch *= friction;
      
      // Auto-rotation de base (très lente)
      angleY += 0.0015;
    }
    
    const cosY = Math.cos(angleY);
    const sinY = Math.sin(angleY);
    const cosP = Math.cos(pitch);
    const sinP = Math.sin(pitch);
    
    const projected = entities.map(ent => {
      // Rotation Y
      const xRot = ent.x * cosY - ent.z * sinY;
      const zRot = ent.x * sinY + ent.z * cosY;
      
      // Rotation X (Pitch)
      const yProj = ent.y * cosP - zRot * sinP;
      const zProj = ent.y * sinP + zRot * cosP;
      
      const depth = 500; 
      const scale = depth / (depth + zProj);
      
      const x2d = (width / 2) + (xRot * scale);
      const y2d = (height / 2) + (yProj * scale);
      
      return { ent, x2d, y2d, zProj, scale };
    });

    projected.sort((a, b) => b.zProj - a.zProj);
    
    projected.forEach((p) => {
      const data = domMap.get(p.ent);
      const g = data.group || data; // Compatibilité avec les docs (group direct)
      
      g.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${p.x2d}, ${p.y2d}) scale(${Math.max(0.1, p.scale)})`);
      
      const isSelected = currentSelectedWord === p.ent;
      const isTargetDoc = currentSelectedWord && p.ent === currentSelectedWord.nearestEntity;
      const baseOpacity = p.ent.type === "doc" ? 0.9 : 0.7;
      const opacity = Math.min(baseOpacity, Math.max(0.1, p.scale * 1.5));
      
      if (isSelected || (isTargetDoc && lineProgress > 0.9)) {
        g.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
        if (data.selectionCircle) {
           data.selectionCircle.style.opacity = "0.6";
           if (data.text) data.text.setAttribute("fill", theme.base3);
           if (data.label) data.label.setAttribute("fill", theme.base3);
        }
      } else {
        const dimmedOpacity = currentSelectedWord && !isTargetDoc ? opacity * 0.3 : opacity;
        g.setAttribute("opacity", dimmedOpacity);
        if (data.selectionCircle) {
          data.selectionCircle.style.opacity = "0";
          if (data.text) data.text.setAttribute("fill", p.ent.color);
          if (data.label) data.label.setAttribute("fill", p.ent.color);
        }
      }
      
      scene.appendChild(g); // Z-Index sorting
    });

    if (currentSelectedWord) {
      lineProgress = Math.min(1, lineProgress + 0.08);
      const pWord = projected.find(p => p.ent === currentSelectedWord);
      const pDoc = projected.find(p => p.ent === currentSelectedWord.nearestEntity);
      if (pWord && pDoc) {
        connectionLine.setAttribute("x1", pWord.x2d);
        connectionLine.setAttribute("y1", pWord.y2d);
        connectionLine.setAttribute("x2", pWord.x2d + (pDoc.x2d - pWord.x2d) * lineProgress);
        connectionLine.setAttribute("y2", pWord.y2d + (pDoc.y2d - pWord.y2d) * lineProgress);
        connectionLine.style.opacity = lineProgress;
        
        // Coordonnées flottantes
        if (lineProgress > 0.3) {
          coordLabelWord.textContent = `[${currentSelectedWord.x.toFixed(0)},${currentSelectedWord.y.toFixed(0)},${currentSelectedWord.z.toFixed(0)}]`;
          coordLabelWord.setAttribute("x", pWord.x2d);
          coordLabelWord.setAttribute("y", pWord.y2d + 20);
          coordLabelWord.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
          coordLabelWord.style.opacity = lineProgress;

          coordLabelDoc.textContent = `[${currentSelectedWord.nearest.x.toFixed(0)},${currentSelectedWord.nearest.y.toFixed(0)},${currentSelectedWord.nearest.z.toFixed(0)}]`;
          coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("x", pDoc.x2d);
          coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("y", pDoc.y2d + 35);
          coordLabelDoc.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
          coordLabelDoc.style.opacity = lineProgress;
        }
      }
    } else {
      lineProgress = 0;
      connectionLine.style.opacity = "0";
      coordLabelWord.style.opacity = "0";
      coordLabelDoc.style.opacity = "0";
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(render3D);
  }

  render3D();

  return svg;
}

::: {.results}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const word = selectedWordEvent;
  
  const term = ui.atom.terminal({header: "RAG_Agent_Trace.log"});
  term.classList.add("is-rag");

  if (!word) {
    term.addLine("Service RAG Initialisé.", "system");
    term.addLine("En attente d'un événement...", "idle");
    const label = term.addLabel("Veuillez cliquer sur un mot dans le graphique 3D.", "success");
    term.addLine(`> ${label}`);
    return term;
  }

  // --- GÉNÉRATION DYNAMIQUE DES ÉTAPES DU TERMINAL ---
  const doc = word.nearest;
  const isKw = word.isKeyWord;
  const score = (100 - word.distance / 5).toFixed(1); // Conversion distance en "Score de Confiance"
  
  // Etape 1: Vectorisation
  term.addLine("[ÉTAPE 1] EXTRACT_EMBEDDING", "scan");
  const wordLabel = term.addLabel(`"${word.text}"`, "success");
  term.addLine(`&nbsp;&nbsp;Token ciblé : ${wordLabel}`);
  term.addLine(`&nbsp;&nbsp;Projection Latente : [X: ${word.x.toFixed(2)}, Y: ${word.y.toFixed(2)}, Z: ${word.z.toFixed(2)}]`);
  term.addLine("&nbsp;&nbsp;> Vectorisation terminée (4ms)", "idle");

  // Etape 2: Recherche (Nearest Neighbor)
  setTimeout(() => {
    term.addLine("[ÉTAPE 2] COSINE_SIMILARITY_SEARCH", "warning");
    term.addLine(`&nbsp;&nbsp;Top-1 Document : <b style="color: ${doc.color};">${doc.id}</b>`);
    term.addProgress("Confiance", score, isKw ? 'success' : 'error');
    term.addLine(`&nbsp;&nbsp;> Distance vectorielle : ${word.distance.toFixed(1)} unités`, "idle");
  }, 300);

  // Etape 3: Résultat (Injection)
  setTimeout(() => {
    term.addLine("[ÉTAPE 3] PROMPT_AUGMENTATION", "success");
    if (isKw) {
       term.addLine("&nbsp;&nbsp;[SUCCÈS] Pertinence sémantique validée.");
       term.addLine(`&nbsp;&nbsp;<div style="padding: 8px; background: rgba(${theme.green_rgb}, 0.1); border-left: 3px solid ${doc.color}; color: ${theme.base0}; font-family: sans-serif;">"${doc.text}"</div>`);
    } else {
       term.addLine("&nbsp;&nbsp;[ÉCHEC] Seuil de pertinence non atteint.", "error");
       term.addLine(`&nbsp;&nbsp;Le document <b style="color:${doc.color}">${doc.id}</b> est trop éloigné.`, "warning");
    }
  }, 700);

  return term;
}
```
